subjects.title: Digital Prototyping & Advanced CAD for Complex Props

subjects.description: Address the critical considerations of prop functionality, user interaction, and safety. Cover principles of ergonomics for actor comfort, structural engineering for durability, weight distribution, and adherence to safety standards for various production environments.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to design props that are not only aesthetically pleasing but also ergonomically sound, structurally robust, and safe for intended use in professional productions.
subjects.title: Ergonomics, Safety, and Performance in Prop Design

subjects.description: Focus on curating a professional-level portfolio showcasing advanced prop design and fabrication skills. Learn best practices for photographing props, documenting processes, creating compelling project descriptions, and presenting work to industry professionals.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will create a comprehensive, professional portfolio demonstrating their mastery of advanced prop design and fabrication, suitable for industry employment.
subjects.title: Portfolio Development & Professional Prop Presentation

courses.description: Principles of eco-design, lifecycle assessment, sustainable materials, and circular economy strategies applied to prop and vehicle development.
courses.title: Sustainable Design for Products & Vehicles

subjects.description: This module introduces the fundamental concepts of sustainability, its relevance to product and vehicle design, and the ethical imperatives for creating environmentally responsible solutions. It sets the stage for understanding the broader impact of design choices.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to articulate the core principles of sustainable design and recognize the environmental, social, and economic implications of product and vehicle development.
subjects.title: Foundations of Sustainable Design

subjects.description: Explore various eco-design principles, strategies, and methodologies, including design for disassembly, material reduction, energy efficiency, and modularity. Students will learn practical approaches to integrate environmental considerations throughout the design process.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to apply eco-design principles and utilize relevant tools to minimize environmental impacts in product and vehicle design projects.
subjects.title: Eco-Design Methodologies

subjects.description: This module focuses on the systematic methodology of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) to evaluate the environmental impacts of products and vehicles from raw material extraction to end-of-life. It covers goal and scope definition, inventory analysis, impact assessment, and interpretation tailored for the industry.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to conduct a basic Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) for a product or vehicle, interpret its results, and identify environmental hotspots.
subjects.title: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)

subjects.description: Dive into the selection and application of sustainable materials, including bio-based, recycled, and low-impact alternatives for props and vehicles. The module also examines green manufacturing processes, additive manufacturing, and advanced material technologies that reduce environmental footprints.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify and evaluate sustainable materials and manufacturing processes suitable for specific product and vehicle applications, considering their environmental performance.
subjects.title: Sustainable Materials & Processes

subjects.description: This module explores the principles and strategies of the circular economy, focusing on how to design products and vehicles for longevity, repairability, remanufacturing, and recycling. It covers concepts like product-as-a-service, closed-loop systems, and waste valorization in the context of the P&V industry.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to integrate circular economy principles into their design thinking, developing strategies for extending product lifespan and closing material loops for props and vehicles.
subjects.title: Circular Economy Strategies

subjects.description: This module examines emerging technologies, future trends, and innovative solutions driving sustainability in product and vehicle design. Topics include autonomous vehicles, electrification, smart materials, digital twins, and the role of policy and consumer behavior in shaping future sustainable mobility.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to analyze and critically evaluate emerging technologies and trends that impact the future of sustainable product and vehicle design.
subjects.title: Future Trends & Innovation

courses.description: Prepare for a professional career, covering intellectual property, contract negotiation, client management, and developing a compelling professional portfolio.
courses.title: Professional Practice & Portfolio Development

subjects.description: Defining your unique professional brand, values, and mission to stand out in the creative industry.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to articulate their professional brand, identify their core values, and define their career objectives.
subjects.title: Establishing Your Professional Identity

subjects.description: Understanding copyright, trademarks, patents, and other intellectual property rights crucial for protecting creative work.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify and protect their intellectual property rights and navigate common legal pitfalls in design.
subjects.title: Intellectual Property & Legal Foundations

subjects.description: Mastering effective client communication, project management, fee negotiation, and drafting robust professional contracts.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to manage client expectations, negotiate fair compensation, and create legally sound contracts for design projects.
subjects.title: Client Relations & Contract Management

subjects.description: Strategies for curating, presenting, and optimizing a professional portfolio that effectively showcases skills and attracts desired opportunities.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to develop a professional portfolio (online and/or physical) that strategically highlights their best work and communicates their unique value.
subjects.title: Building a Compelling Professional Portfolio

subjects.description: Exploring diverse career paths, networking techniques, job search strategies, and continuous professional development in the design industry.
subjects.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify relevant career opportunities, implement effective job search strategies, and plan for ongoing professional development.
subjects.title: Career Strategies & Professional Growth
